body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy deals Damage to you with a melee Action. Response: After its Damage, on success deal 2 weapon Damage.

surges.html: On a hit, push the enemy 1 unit away from an adjacent ally, or from yourself.
Make yourself or one willing ally within 3 units Rallied until the start of your next turn.
